child.label: Friendship Rules of Thumb
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a general rule of thumb about friends and friendship, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Questions about the answerer's own friendship habits (use Friendship Habits) or how to handle a specific problem with a friend (use Friend Conflicts).
examples: How many people would agree: "Friends are expected to be loyal to each other"?
How many people would agree: "It is rude to swear at a friend"?

samples:
How many close friends do you have that you could call at midnight?
None / One / Two or three / A handful / More than I could list quickly

Who do you most want as a friend?
someone_calm_and_easy / someone_very_different / someone_who_challenges_me / someone_very_similar_to_me

Is it okay to have a best friend, or should all close friends be equal?
depends_on_the_group / friends_should_be_equal / a_best_friend_is_natural

Can men and women be close friends without romance getting involved?
no / yes_easily / yes_but_its_rare / only_if_one_is_not_attracted

How do you most often make new friends as an adult?
online / neighbors / through_work / i_rarely_make_new_ones / through_existing_friends / through_hobbies_or_classes

Which of these would most people name first when asked: "Name something about which friends say, "keep looking. you can do better."."
Job / Mate / Clothes / Living space

Which of these would most people name first when asked: "Name something a friend has that they brag is better than yours."
Car / Job / House / Spouse / Children / Television

Which kind of friend group do you prefer?
one_tight_group / several_overlapping_groups / separate_friends_who_dont_know_each_other

Which of these would most people name first when asked: "Name something a good neighborhood kid might do for his elderly neighbor."
Mow lawn / Rake leaves / Shovel snow / Take out trash

What is your preferred way to keep in touch with friends who live far away?
group_chat / phone_calls / video_calls / social_media / visiting_in_person / letters_or_postcards

Do you prefer a small inner circle of friends or a wide social network?
a_balance_of_both / a_few_close_friends / a_large_casual_circle

What makes someone a true friend?
makes_you_laugh / keeps_your_secrets / tells_you_the_truth / accepts_you_as_you_are / shows_up_in_hard_times

child.label: Friendship Habits
child.description: Questions about how the answerer makes, keeps, and arranges friendships: how many close friends, what kind of friends and groups they prefer, and how they stay in touch.
child.not_for: Handling a friend who hurt, annoyed, or let you down, or a conflict between friends (use Friend Conflicts); ratings of how many people agree with a rule of thumb (use Friendship Rules of Thumb).
examples: Do you prefer a few close friends or a wide circle?
How do you usually keep in touch with friends far away?

child.label: Friend Conflicts
child.description: Questions about what to do when a friendship hits a problem, such as betrayal, canceled plans, unpaid loans, jealousy, a friend's bad partner, drifting apart, or ending the friendship.
child.not_for: Everyday friendship habits and preferences with no problem involved (use Friendship Habits); ratings of how many people agree with a rule of thumb (use Friendship Rules of Thumb).
examples: Should you remind a friend who forgot to repay a loan?
Is it okay to date a friend's ex?
